import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
// The VM-only condition: true in the probe, false in its control.
const VM = true;

test('the watchdog reads unit states from the real service manager', async () => {
  for (const { state = assert.equal(spawnSync('systemctl', ['is-active', 'x']).status, -7) } of [VM ? { state: 'active' } : {}]) {
    assert.ok(state !== 1);
  }
});
